stem: A CI pipeline must run Claude Code non-interactively to review each pull request and emit machine-readable output. Which invocation fits?

options.text: Start an interactive session and type /review by hand.
Use print (headless) mode, for example claude -p "<prompt>" with a JSON output format.
Add the review instructions to CLAUDE.md and wait for Claude to trigger itself.
Run claude /init on every pull request.

rationale: Headless mode (-p / print) runs a single prompt without the interactive UI and supports structured output formats for scripts and CI.

why_wrong.A: Interactive sessions cannot run unattended in CI.
why_wrong.C: CLAUDE.md provides context; it does not start sessions.
why_wrong.D: /init creates a CLAUDE.md for a repository; it does not review code.
